qualification.rationale: The proposal identifies encoding the image for autosave as the failed operation. It avoids the cumbersome automatikus mentési kép noun stack without implying a completed save or loss of the existing draft. Static origin is the canvas PNG compression failure; the exact raw exception message is recorded rather than directly displayed in the current main activity.

The same grammatical improvement correctly applies to the floating selection, not the full canvas. Kijelölést remains the accusative object of kódolni. Static origin is floating PNG compression failure; do not equate its recording in lastAutosaveError with a verified visible notice.

Alsó szél is a noun phrase suitable both for the visible edge field and as possessor in the composed vágása label. It repairs the adverb Alul vágása while retaining the bottom-edge referent. Acceptance covers these static field/template uses, not actual screen-reader delivery.

The polite imperatives koppintson, tartsa nyomva and görgessen form coherent gesture instructions. Előtérszín and háttérszín specify colour selection rather than vaguely referring to spatial foreground/background. The object of tartsa nyomva is recoverable from egy színre, and the actual swatches have distinct click and long-click handlers.

The swatch instruction preserves the hexadecimal value and the foreground-tap/background-hold distinction using grammatical imperatives. The colon after Szín is natural for a value label. Tartsa nyomva is a normal long-press instruction without needing an additional time promise.

Rajzolás folytatása is idiomatic for resuming the previously used drawing tool. The consumer is the navigation/zoom panel button calling chooseTool(drawingTool), not Undo/Redo or a command to redraw the image from scratch, so folytatása clarifies the intended action.

The proposed sentence correctly expresses fixed coordinates relative to the top-left corner, not retention of only a group of top-left pixels. It preserves right/bottom clipping and Undo. The static non-stretch implementation draws the old bitmap at 0,0 on the new canvas, supporting this reading.

Bal alone is serviceable as a terse visible direction, but Bal vágása is awkward as a standalone composed description. Bal szél supplies the noun required by the possessive construction while remaining accurate for the trim-from-left field.
Jobb szél is accurate as an edge noun phrase and composes naturally as Jobb szél vágása. It removes the awkward adjectival ellipsis in Jobb vágása without changing crop direction or units.

The proposal naturally reports an unsuccessful completed attempt and treats the recovery copy as the preserved role of the moved draft. It does not claim the old draft was successfully saved. The originating helper throws it for a missing source or failed rename; the current recovery caller can replace this raw error with a general preservation notice, so no direct rendering of this exact sentence is claimed.

The hyphenated shared-head list correctly attaches fájlt to the image/PDF format names, while illetve separates Base64-encoded image text. This fixes the current reading that the entire format list modifies képszöveget. All formats are preserved and the text does not promise every file with those extensions is decodable. Képszöveget is a technical compound but its Base64 qualifier makes the intended text representation clear enough; no further rewrite is required for this bounded correction.

Felső szél supplies the missing edge noun in both the field label and the generated possessive crop description. It fixes Felül vágása consistently with the three priority edge proposals. This is an isolated adjacent P2 proposal assessment, not review of the P2 tier.

Annál makes the comparative relation to zero explicit and fluent. Zero remains allowed, and the wording retains the numeric trim-value requirement. The old wording was understandable by ellipsis; this is a clarity correction, not proof of a different accepted numeric range. The finite-number check is broader than the English explanation and is not silently added to the translation.

Both proposed quantity forms restore the modal elmozdíthatja (may move) and name the affected objects as hozzájuk csatolt képeket (images attached to them), not abstract attachments. The generic plural elhelyezett képek is appropriate in both forms because the final sentence is a general warning, just as in English; the count-specific sentence correctly uses the singular noun képre after a Hungarian numeral. Static attachment layout depends on the parent edge, so cropping can move children but need not move all of them.

The candidate restores every source component: the app-language title, maintenance in the language resources, and English fallback for new/untranslated text. It removes the current unsupported assertion that all translatable UI text is present. The first-person plural tartjuk karban is a conventional product voice, not an extra service commitment.

The instrumental színnel fits the still-image description, színszórás is coherent with the existing adjacent Színek szórása checkbox, and GIF-ekből az első képkocka clearly describes which part is opened. The proposal retains the 256-colour limit and makes no animation-support promise.

Memóriaigénye correctly makes the combined memory requirement the subject of the budget comparison. The article before kódolási pufferek and the possessive memóriakeretét produce a natural complete Hungarian sentence. No cause beyond the source budget excess is added.

The impersonal failed-action construction is idiomatic and preserves the attempted replacement, rather than giving the completed image human agency. The destination file remains the object. This is acceptable both in export replacement and in the shared Base64 import replacement helper.

Visszavonási előzményeket is the natural collective/plural UI expression here. The separate success and failure clauses preserve the distinction between recovered canvas and unreadable undo history. The second sentence retains the original-draft recovery copy and does not imply the undo history was recovered. The notice is assigned only after the copy-preservation call returns.
